title: Ahko Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for @mrjacket/ahko declarative configuration files (config.ahko.json)

default.description: Default scheduler profile applied when no named profile is requested

profiles.description: Named scheduler profiles for distinct workloads (e.g. crawler, critical-gateway, background-sync)

concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent active tasks allowed to run simultaneously.

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum interval in milliseconds between consecutive task starts (rate limiting).

oneOf.description: Custom numerical priority weight. Higher weights execute first.

priority.description: Default priority weight for tasks scheduled under this profile.

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds when strategy is 'delay'.

timeoutMs.description: Per-attempt active execution deadline in milliseconds before aborting with AhkoTimeoutError.

totalTimeoutMs.description: Overarching task deadline in milliseconds spanning queue wait, retries, and execution.

attempts.description: Total execution attempts (e.g. 3 = initial attempt + 2 retries).

backoff.description: Backoff curve strategy between retry attempts.

maxDelay.description: Maximum backoff delay ceiling in milliseconds.

jitter.description: Whether to apply full jitter randomization to retry backoff intervals.

failureThreshold.description: Number of consecutive failures required to trip the circuit to OPEN.

resetTimeoutMs.description: Cool-down window in milliseconds before attempting recovery in HALF_OPEN.

tags.description: Default classification tags associated with tasks scheduled under this profile.

targetLatencyMs.description: Target latency threshold in milliseconds. Exceeding this triggers multiplicative decrease.

sampleWindowSize.description: Number of settled task latency samples required before adjusting concurrency.

minConcurrency.description: Floor limit for adaptive concurrency reduction.

maxConcurrency.description: Ceiling limit for adaptive concurrency increase.

backoffFactor.description: Multiplicative decrease factor when target latency is exceeded (e.g. 0.5 cuts concurrency in half).

adaptive.description: AIMD adaptive concurrency policy for dynamic congestion avoidance.
